description: Create a new broadcast message in draft status. Provide recipients directly or use recipientSources to resolve from contact lists. The WhatsApp channel is auto-resolved if not specified.

botId.description: Identifier (UUID) of a bot to send through. Each recipient's channel is picked by the bot's load-balancer + sticky sessions. Takes precedence over channelId.

channelId.description: Identifier (UUID) of the WhatsApp channel to send through (auto-resolved from default channel if omitted)

mediaUrl.description: URL of media to attach (required for image or document message types)

message.description: Message content to broadcast to recipients (optional when sending a template)

messageType.description: Type of message to send (e.g., 'text', 'image', 'document', or 'template' on official API sessions)

name.description: Display name or label for the broadcast

recipientSources.description: Resolve recipients dynamically from contact lists with filtering and exclusion

excludeListIds.description: Contact list identifiers (UUIDs or slugs) to exclude from recipients

filters.description: Additional filters to narrow down recipients

tags.description: Only include contacts matching these tags

listIds.description: Contact list identifiers (UUIDs or slugs) to include as recipients

phones.description: Individual phone numbers in E.164 format to include

recipients.description: Direct list of recipients (alternative to recipientSources)

contactName.description: Display name of the recipient contact

phone.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g., '+2348012345678')

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time for scheduled broadcast delivery (e.g., '2025-12-31T10:00:00Z'). Creates as draft if omitted.

template.description: Approved template (official WhatsApp Business API sessions only). On official API sessions, use one for broadcasts: most recipients won't have messaged you in the last 24 hours, and only templates reach them. Set messageType to 'template'.

components.description: Meta send-time components with variable values, e.g. [{ type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Ada' }] }]. Omit for templates without variables.

name.description: Template name exactly as approved (see neuron_list_whatsapp_templates)

name: neuron_create_broadcast
title: Create Broadcast
